entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have that order number? And just to be clear, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Order is 774-B1-900. It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is complete garbage. It's off by 30 beats a minute.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. I can definitely try to help you troubleshoot that. Sometimes a simple firmware reset or checking the fit on your wrist can resolve...
Look, I don't have time for a science project. The thing doesn't work. I just want money back. Can you process a refund or not?
I understand you're frustrated and want a quick resolution. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, I see your order. It was delivered 25 days ago on December 15th.
Yes. So, can I return it?
Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.
Great. Finally. What do I need to do?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
